bio: Daughter of Samuel Thompson & Hannah Brewster, granddaughter of John Thompson of Setauket (John's 11th-great-grandfather): 1st cousin 10 times removed. Married Thomas Strong 16 Aug 1734; children Selah, Abigail, Submit, Ruth, Mary, Susannah, Zipporah, Hannah and Katurah ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
